projects.title: Residential Property Valuation Using Machine Learning
projects.objective: House price prediction is a widely researched area in the field of data science and machine learning due to its practical importance in the real estate industry. Numerous studies have been conducted to develop models that can accurately estimate property prices based on various factors such as location, area, number of rooms, and nearby amenities.
projects.description: Historically, house price approximation was based chiefly on professional assessments, past performances analysis, and manual comparisons. These traditional means, though, tend to bog down when processing the increasing depth and volume of contemporary real estate information. Such is where Machine Learning (ML) prevails by assessing large data collections, discovering elusive patterns, and providing precise forecasting.

projects.title: The Voice Assistant with Desktop Accessibility
projects.objective: Creating accessible and intuitive technology is crucial for enhancing user experiences in today’s digital world. Our project, AI-Powered Voice Assistant with Desktop Accessibility, harnesses advanced artificial intelligence (AI) to transform how users interact with their desktops.
projects.description: The assistant features state-of-the-art Speech Recognition (SR) to seamlessly convert spoken commands into text, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to understand and interpret these commands. With Text-to-Speech (TTS) technology, it provides clear and responsive voice feedback, delivering a complete hands-free desktop experience.

projects.title: PDF Summarizer Chatbot using RAG
projects.objective: Paperbrain-PDF-Summarizer-chatbot-using-RAG- A privacy-first, fully offline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbot for querying PDF documents. Powered by FastAPI, Streamlit, ChromaDB, and local LLMs via Ollama. PaperBrain: AI-Powered PDF Question Answering System.
projects.description: This is Local and Private: No documents or chats leave your machine. Embeddings, vector storage, and language generation (via Ollama) run locally. Hybrid Search (Dense + Sparse): Fuses dense vector similarity search (Sentence Transformers) with BM25 keyword matching to deliver highly accurate context retrieval.
